features.description: Add a resolution contract to the ActionItem model: a machine-checkable `clears_when` predicate (the condition whose falsity produced the item) plus a `resolution_class` enum — command_resolvable | chained | operator_attested | blocked_external. Pure model + a pure `evaluate(clears_when, live_state) -> bool` function. No emitter wiring yet.
steps: Add clears_when (structured predicate ref + params) and resolution_class enum to the ActionItem dataclass in operator_console.py
Define the predicate vocabulary as a closed registry of named, pure checks over live state (e.g. plan_active_and_gate_uncleared, install_snapshot_present_and_cache_fresh)
Implement evaluate_clears_when(item, state) pure function returning bool
Serialize the new fields in to_dict(); keep reversible/plain_consequence
Unit tests: each predicate true/false; resolution_class round-trips; evaluate() is pure (no I/O)
features.acceptance: ActionItem carries clears_when (a reference into a CLOSED named-predicate registry + bound params; no expression eval) and resolution_class constrained to exactly {command_resolvable, chained, operator_attested, blocked_external}; evaluate_clears_when() is a pure function (zero I/O) returning the correct boolean for each registered predicate; to_dict() serializes the fields. Verified by unit tests covering every registry predicate true/false.

evidence_refs.note: closed predicate registry + ClearsWhen + 4 resolution classes + pure evaluate_clears_when
ActionItem gains clears_when + resolution_class (additive); validated + serialized

features.description: Round-trip recompute guarantee in state production: when building dashboard/what-now state, every candidate ActionItem is re-evaluated against LIVE state via F001, and an item whose clears_when is already satisfied is NOT emitted (suppress-at-source). Global-scope predicates are evaluated once at fleet/home scope, never gated behind a per-project precondition (e.g. a per-project capabilities/ dir).
steps: Route all ActionItem emission in the state producer through a single evaluate-and-filter seam using F001
Suppress any item whose clears_when(live_state) is already True
Move global-scope predicate evaluation (install snapshot / capabilities readiness) to fleet/home scope, decoupled from per-project capabilities/ dirs
Stamp each emitted item + the state envelope with the live-state generated_at used for evaluation
Tests: an already-satisfied condition yields no item; a global predicate evaluates with no project capabilities/ dir present; re-running the producer after the condition flips drops the item
features.acceptance: State production assembles one LiveState snapshot and emits an ActionItem only when its clears_when is false (SUPPRESS-AT-SOURCE), recording an audit note for each suppression; global predicates evaluate at fleet scope regardless of per-project dirs; re-running after a condition resolves drops the item. Verified by tests including the no-project-capabilities-dir global case + a suppression-audit assertion.

features.description: Proof case A — phantom suppression. Gate/approve (and sibling) ActionItems carry clears_when = plan-is-active-and-gate-uncleared; via F002 they are suppressed for plans whose status is completed/abandoned (and superseded). Targets the live failure where 54/57 gate-approve cards point at closed plans.
steps: Set clears_when on gate/approve emitters to plan_active_and_gate_uncleared
Confirm F002 suppression drops gate cards for completed/abandoned/superseded plans
Regression fixture mirroring the live ledger: assert no gate card survives for a completed/abandoned plan; active-plan gates still surface
Capture before/after NEEDS-ACTION counts as evidence
features.acceptance: After rebuild, zero gate/approve ActionItems exist for completed/abandoned/superseded plans; gates for active plans remain; a fixture reproducing the 54/57 phantom case goes to 0 phantom. Evidence records the count drop.

features.description: Proof case B — global reconcile/readiness round-trip. The install-snapshot/capabilities readiness item is emitted at fleet scope with clears_when = snapshot present AND status cache fresh; when one step surfaces another it is resolution_class=chained and names the next exact command (baseline → capabilities status); credential/deploy steps are resolution_class=operator_attested and clear on captured evidence, not a command. Running the offered/chained action(s) → rebuild → item clears.
steps: Emit the readiness item at fleet scope with the composite clears_when (snapshot + fresh cache)
When clears_when stays false after the primary command, emit the chained next action (capabilities status) rather than re-emitting the same card
Mark credential/deploy actions operator_attested with an evidence_expected ref; clear on evidence presence
Test the full round-trip: simulate baseline → still flagged → capabilities status → rebuild → card cleared; operator_attested item clears only when evidence ref present
features.acceptance: The global readiness card round-trips: after running baseline (and the chained capabilities status), a rebuild clears it; if a step needs credentials/deploy it is operator_attested and clears on evidence, never silently auto-cleared. Verified by a round-trip test.

features.description: Generic round-trip invariant across ALL ActionItem emitters: a property test that, for every item an emitter can produce, applies the suggested command/evidence (simulated against live-state fixtures), recomputes via F002, and asserts the item clears — OR the item is explicitly resolution_class operator_attested/blocked_external (and then asserts it clears on evidence, and that command-resolvable items are NOT mislabeled). Makes non-resolving guidance a build-time failure.
steps: Enumerate ActionItem emitters (gates, breakers, reconcile, capabilities, plan_drift, operations_guidance, …)
For each, build a fixture that triggers the item, apply its exact_command/evidence to the fixture state, recompute, assert clears_when flips to satisfied
Allow operator_attested/blocked_external to opt out of command-clears, but require they clear on evidence and carry evidence_expected
Fail the test if any emitter yields an item that neither clears via its command nor is explicitly attested/blocked
features.acceptance: A single invariant test covers every ActionItem emitter and proves condition → action/evidence → recompute → clear, or the item is explicitly operator_attested/blocked_external with an evidence path; an emitter producing non-resolving guidance fails the test. Runs in the orchestrate sweep.
